name: Sunless Empire
summary: Sunless Empire is a set of 10 Aztec themed maps (+1 Credits Map) by the Waffle House Team for Doom 2 in MBF21 format. The set features new textures by Ludi and muumi along with a fully bespoke soundtrack by Korp, LVENdead, and LPad. The monsters have also received cosmetic changes that do not affect gameplay, and a weaker green cyber has been added to the roster. This set starts out with smaller, easier maps but makes a pretty big leap in both scale and difficulty in the last third.
